channel.title: Agent Stack Brief · English
channel.description: AI agent tools: changes, practical decisions, and exercises.

item.title: 002 · Make agent work observable
item.description:
• Skill Scanner 2.3.0 reports unscanned symlinks and load failures; review CI rules.
  • Chrome DevTools MCP 1.11.0 diagnostics; separate DevTools UI and Docs MCP documentation-review cases.
  • Deep Agents 0.7.26–0.7.28 improves async status reporting and glob path handling.

item.title: 001 · Before adding tools, check the boundaries
item.description:
• agent-browser 0.39.1 prevents duplicate execution after a lost response; inspect before retrying.
  • Deep Agents 0.7.25 checks path permissions with symlink targets in mind.
  • Skill Scanner 2.2.1 and 2.2.2 fixes: update the scanner before reviewing third-party skills.
